description: Retrieve events from the current or a previous session. Returns the raw episodic record — messages, tool calls, tool results, and artifacts in sequence order. Use this to recall what happened earlier in a conversation (especially after context compaction), or to review a previous session.

after_sequence.description: Only return events after this sequence number (for pagination).

session_id.description: Session to query (matches MCP or client session ID). Omit for the current session.

name: get_events
